title: KESTREL v2 · Original fictional ring-ice pusher

subject.summary: Original crewed ring-ice pusher. Long compression spine, raised two-deck bow cab, articulated four-jaw empty cradle and thrust-parallel folding radiators. An engineering-informed game design, not a flight-qualified spacecraft. Additive close-up refinement of KESTREL-final; all original part definitions remain unchanged.

sources.title: NASA-CR-114938: Reusable Space Tug, spacecraft concepts and systems design, 1971
NASA NTRS 20000032541: Thermal Radiator Pointing for International Space Station (1999)

authoring.provenance_note: Additive revision of the supplied fictional KESTREL-final. All 256 original part dictionaries are locked; new hardware is designed/inferred. The original research references are inherited, with no new external research in this revision.

how: Original fictional spacecraft designed for the supplied game brief.
NASA modular-tug, ISS truss and thermal-control reasoning informs the architecture; no vehicle is copied.
Every vessel dimension and hardware shape is designed/inferred. No flight-performance claim is made.
The stock viewer uses GENERIC RECONSTRUCTION for all generic scenes; here it means an original concept, not a reconstruction of an existing ship.
